disciplines.name: Curated Knowledge, Developer Guides, Books & Awesome Collections
disciplines.description: Curated knowledge aggregation, community-driven awesome lists, canonical developer roadmaps, interactive CS curricula, free programming books, and public API registries that synthesize technical literature and learning pathways.

disciplines.name: Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models, Foundation Models & Quantization
disciplines.description: Pre-trained foundation models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, efficient model serving engines, quantization techniques (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA).

disciplines.name: Multi-Agent Systems, Autonomous Swarms, AI Orchestration & MCP Tools
disciplines.description: Autonomous multi-agent coordination frameworks, cognitive architectures, swarm intelligence, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations, planning engines, execution DAGs, and autonomous developer agents.

disciplines.name: Computer Vision, Multimodal AI, Diffusion & Neural Rendering (NeRF/3D-GS)
disciplines.description: Visual perception, image segmentation, object detection, multimodal vision-language models (VLM), generative latent diffusion pipelines, and 3D neural rendering including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS).

disciplines.name: Speech, Voice AI, Audio Processing, Audio Synthesis & Music Generation
disciplines.description: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), neural voice cloning, acoustic feature extraction, real-time voice conversion, and deep generative audio/music synthesis.

disciplines.name: Robotics, Humanoid Kinematics, Dynamics, Actuators & Physics Simulation
disciplines.description: Rigid-body kinematics and dynamics algorithms, humanoid bipedal locomotion, zero-moment point (ZMP) balance, robotic actuator control, spatial trajectory optimization, and GPU-accelerated physics simulation.

disciplines.name: Autonomous Vehicles, Mobile Robotics, LiDAR SLAM & Drone Flight Control
disciplines.description: Autonomous driving software stacks, mobile robotic navigation, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) using LiDAR and visual-inertial odometry, and UAV/drone autopilot systems.

disciplines.name: Semiconductor, Silicon EDA, RTL-to-GDSII, FPGA & RISC-V Architecture
disciplines.description: Electronic Design Automation (EDA), register-transfer level (RTL) synthesis, physical placement and routing (P&R), formal hardware verification, FPGA bitstream toolchains, and open-source RISC-V processor architectures.

disciplines.name: Quantum Computing, Quantum Algorithms, Circuit Simulation & Error Correction
disciplines.description: Quantum circuit synthesis, unitary statevector and density matrix simulation, quantum variational algorithms (VQE, QAOA), quantum error correction (QEC surface codes), and quantum programming frameworks.

disciplines.name: Superconducting Systems, Cryogenics & Energy Storage (SMES)
disciplines.description: High- and low-temperature superconductivity simulation, Ginzburg-Landau and London vortex dynamics, cryogenic thermal refrigeration cycles, and Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) systems.

disciplines.name: Spintronics, Micromagnetics & Atomistic Spin Dynamics (LLG)
disciplines.description: Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation solvers, micromagnetic finite-difference simulations, magnetic skyrmion dynamics, spin-transfer torque (STT/SOT), and spintronic non-volatile memory architectures.

disciplines.name: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, Tokamaks & Particle Accelerators
disciplines.description: Magnetic confinement fusion, Grad-Shafranov equilibrium solvers, magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) plasma stability, Particle-in-Cell (PIC) kinetic simulations, and particle accelerator beam dynamics.

disciplines.name: Clean Energy, Solid Oxide Fuel Cells, Batteries & Power Grids
disciplines.description: Electrochemical energy conversion and storage, Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN/P2D) lithium-ion battery modeling, solid oxide and PEM fuel cell thermodynamics, and electric grid distribution power flow simulation.

disciplines.name: Space Systems, Orbital Astrodynamics, Satellite Tracking & Rocket Propulsion
disciplines.description: Celestial mechanics, orbital trajectory propagation, satellite ephemeris determination, multi-body gravitational mechanics, and chemical/electric rocket propulsion thermochemistry.

disciplines.name: Spacecraft Proximity Operations, Docking & Deployable Structures
disciplines.description: Relative spacecraft motion, Clohessy-Wiltshire (Hill's) rendezvous equations, autonomous terminal guidance and docking mechanisms, and deployable space structures/solar array kinematics.

disciplines.name: Gravitational Wave Astronomy, Precision Metrology & Casimir Physics
disciplines.description: Laser interferometric gravitational wave detection, matched filtering of compact binary coalescences, quantum optomechanical metrology, and macroscopic Casimir force physics.

disciplines.name: Aerospace Aerodynamics, Hypersonics & Rarefied Gas Dynamics
disciplines.description: Compressible aerodynamics, high-enthalpy hypersonic boundary layers, shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions, and Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) for rarefied gas regimes.

disciplines.name: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Turbulence & Multiphase Slosh
disciplines.description: Incompressible and multiphase Navier-Stokes solvers, Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS), Large Eddy Simulation (LES), Lattice Boltzmann Methods (LBM), and propellant slosh dynamics.

disciplines.name: Peridynamics, Structural Mechanics, FEA & Non-Local Fracture
disciplines.description: Non-local peridynamic continuum mechanics, material crack nucleation and dynamic fracture propagation, finite element analysis (FEA), and non-linear constitutive structural mechanics.

disciplines.name: Additive Manufacturing, Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) & 3D Slicing
disciplines.description: Thermal melt pool kinetics, laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) process modeling, residual stress and distortion prediction, G-code slicing algorithms, and additive manufacturing toolpaths.

disciplines.name: Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) & Structural Health Monitoring (SHM)
disciplines.description: High-density LiDAR point cloud registration, surface deformation analysis, structural modal vibration identification, digital twin calibration, and civil infrastructure health monitoring.

disciplines.name: Subsurface Geomechanics, Geothermal (EGS) & Nuclear Waste Vitrification
disciplines.description: Thermo-hydro-mechanical-chemical (THMC) subsurface coupled processes, enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) fracture flow, reservoir stimulation, and radioactive waste repository geological containment.

disciplines.name: Acoustic Levitation, Acoustofluidics & Phased Array Manipulation
disciplines.description: Ultrasound phased array acoustic radiation force computation, Gor'kov acoustic potential fields, contactless particle levitation, and acoustofluidic microparticle separation.

disciplines.name: Marine Hydrodynamics, Sonar Transducer Arrays & Ocean Engineering
disciplines.description: Computational ship hydrodynamics, wave-body boundary element methods (BEM), sonar transducer beamforming, underwater acoustics propagation, and autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) dynamics.

disciplines.name: Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, LiDAR & Earth Observation
disciplines.description: Numerical weather prediction (NWP), mesoscale atmospheric boundary layer modeling, Doppler weather radar and aerosol LiDAR processing, and planetary satellite climatology analysis.

disciplines.name: Healthcare, Computational Biomedicine, Drug Discovery & Molecular Modeling
disciplines.description: Structure-based virtual screening, molecular docking algorithms, physiological pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling, protein-ligand binding affinity prediction, and biomedical deep learning.

disciplines.name: Genomics, CRISPR Gene Editing & Synthetic Biology
disciplines.description: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) alignment, CRISPR-Cas gRNA on-target efficiency and off-target cleavage prediction, gene circuit metabolic synthesis, and genomic variant calling.

disciplines.name: Neurotechnology, Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) & Neuromorphic Computing
disciplines.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) and intracortical neural spike decoding, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP), Riemannian geometry decoders, motor imagery classification, and spiking neural networks (SNN).

disciplines.name: Smart Cities, Building Information Modeling (BIM/IFC) & Urban Mobility
disciplines.description: OpenBIM Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) 3D geometric parsing, automated spatial clash detection, multi-modal urban traffic flow microsimulation, and smart city digital twin sensor networks.

disciplines.name: Cybersecurity, Reverse Engineering, Binary Exploitation & Vulnerability Research
disciplines.description: Binary disassembly, control flow graph recovery, symbolic execution, coverage-guided fuzzing, automated vulnerability research, malware dynamic analysis, and red team exploitation.

disciplines.name: Industrial Automation, SCADA, PLC Ladder Logic, OPC-UA & Hardware Security
disciplines.description: IEC 61131-3 programmable logic controller (PLC) runtimes, ladder diagram compilation, OPC-UA industrial telemetry pub/sub, Modbus/DNP3 protocols, and industrial supervisory control.

disciplines.name: Cryptography, Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Post-Quantum & Privacy Tech
disciplines.description: Non-interactive zero-knowledge arguments of knowledge (zk-SNARKs/zk-STARKs), arithmetic constraint satisfaction (R1CS), lattice-based post-quantum cryptography, and secure multi-party computation.

disciplines.name: Formal Verification, Theorem Proving & Mathematical Proof Systems
disciplines.description: Interactive theorem proving (Coq, Lean, Isabelle), Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) automated solvers, deductive software verification, and mathematically proven invariant systems.

disciplines.name: EdTech, Adaptive Learning, Cognitive Scaffolding & STEM Assessment
disciplines.description: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), item response theory (IRT), dynamic STEM question generation with SymPy/LaTeX verification, automated grading rubrics, and Socratic cognitive tutoring.

disciplines.name: Fintech, Core Banking, Payment Protocols & Algorithmic Trading
disciplines.description: Ultra-low-latency event-driven algorithmic backtesting, limit order book microstructure, ISO 20022/FIX payment exchange protocols, options pricing models, and double-entry accounting ledgers.

disciplines.name: Blockchain, Web3, Smart Contracts & EVM/Solana Engineering
disciplines.description: Decentralized consensus runtimes, Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) Yul bytecode execution, Solana Sealevel Anchor parallel execution, DeFi automated market maker (AMM) math, and smart contract verification.

disciplines.name: Database Engines, Distributed SQL, NoSQL, Vector DBs & Persistent Caches
disciplines.description: High-performance storage engines, Log-Structured Merge-trees (LSM), B+tree index algorithms, distributed consensus SQL transactions (Raft/Paxos), and Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) vector databases.

disciplines.name: Data Engineering, Distributed Analytics, Stream Processing (Kafka/Spark) & ETL
disciplines.description: High-throughput distributed event streaming, Kafka/Spark partition rebalancing, lakehouse columnar storage formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake), and scalable real-time ETL data pipelines.

disciplines.name: Cloud-Native Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Containers & Service Meshes
disciplines.description: Container virtualization runtimes, declarative Kubernetes operators, cloud orchestration, Envoy service mesh proxies, distributed cloud elasticity, and multi-tenant cluster management.

disciplines.name: CI/CD Automation, GitOps & Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Ansible)
disciplines.description: Continuous integration and deployment pipelines, declarative GitOps reconciliation (ArgoCD, Flux), Infrastructure-as-Code configuration automation (Terraform, Ansible), and release engineering.

disciplines.name: Observability, APM Telemetry, Metrics, Distributed Tracing & Logging
disciplines.description: OpenTelemetry unified collection protocols, high-cardinality time-series metrics storage, distributed request tracing, log aggregation, and site reliability engineering (SRE) alert synthesis.

disciplines.name: Networking, Reverse Proxies, Load Balancers, Edge Gateways & API Gateways
disciplines.description: High-concurrency reverse proxy engines, dynamic layer 4/layer 7 load balancing algorithms, edge worker runtimes, eBPF network filtering, and modern internet transport protocols (HTTP/3, QUIC).

disciplines.name: Operating Systems, Linux Kernels, Low-Level Drivers & Emulators
disciplines.description: Monolithic and microkernel architectures, Linux kernel subsystems, virtual memory management, device driver engineering, hardware virtualization hypervisors (KVM), and hardware CPU emulation.

disciplines.name: Compilers, Interpreters, Virtual Machines, Language Toolchains & JIT Engines
disciplines.description: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing, LLVM Intermediate Representation (IR) optimization pipelines, register allocation algorithms, bytecode interpreters, and Just-In-Time (JIT) runtime compilation.

disciplines.name: Systems Programming, Low-Level Runtimes, Memory Safety & WebAssembly (Wasm)
disciplines.description: Bare-metal runtime environments, compile-time borrow checking and memory safety, lock-free concurrent data structures, asynchronous I/O primitives, and zero-cost abstraction systems programming.

disciplines.name: Developer Tooling, Shell Environments, Terminal Emulators & CLI Utilities
disciplines.description: Interactive terminal emulators, Unix shell scripting environments, terminal multiplexing (tmux), high-performance CLI utilities, and developer productivity workstation tools.

disciplines.name: Code Editors, IDEs, Syntax Plugins, Language Server Protocols (LSP) & Linters
disciplines.description: Modern modal and extensible code editors (Neovim, VSCode), Language Server Protocol (LSP) language servers, Tree-sitter incremental syntax parsing, and IDE plugin ecosystems.

disciplines.name: Game Development Engines, 2D/3D Graphics APIs & Shaders (WebGL/Vulkan)
disciplines.description: Real-time 2D/3D game engines, scene graph scene management, modern graphics hardware APIs (Vulkan, DirectX 12, Metal, WebGPU), and programmable GPU shading pipelines.

disciplines.name: Modern Frontend Frameworks, Reactive Web Engines (React/Vue/Svelte) & Bundlers
disciplines.description: Virtual DOM and fine-grained reactive signal engines, server-side rendering (SSR), incremental static generation, modern JavaScript runtimes, and optimized web module bundlers (Vite/Turbopack).

disciplines.name: UI Component Systems, Design Tokens, Iconography & Animation Libraries
disciplines.description: Accessible unstyled headless UI primitives (Radix, ARIA), design token systems, utility-first CSS engines (Tailwind), SVG icon design systems, and hardware-accelerated web animation engines.

disciplines.name: Mobile App Development, Cross-Platform Frameworks (Flutter/React Native) & SDKs
disciplines.description: Cross-platform mobile runtimes (Flutter, React Native), native platform bindings (iOS Swift / Android Kotlin), mobile hardware sensor interfaces, and offline-first mobile data sync.

disciplines.name: Desktop Application Frameworks, GUI Toolkits (Electron/Tauri/Qt) & Document Utilities
disciplines.description: Native desktop GUI application frameworks, memory-efficient webview windowing shells (Tauri, Electron), multi-platform C++/Rust GUI widget libraries (Qt, Dear ImGui), and OS window integration.

disciplines.name: Backend Web Frameworks, Microservices, REST / GraphQL / gRPC APIs & ORMs
disciplines.description: High-performance asynchronous backend web servers, microservice architecture middleware, typed REST/GraphQL/gRPC API contracts, Object-Relational Mappers (ORM), and authentication security.

disciplines.name: Multimedia Processing, Audio/Video Codecs, FFmpeg & Streaming Pipelines
disciplines.description: Hardware-accelerated video decoding and encoding pipelines, FFmpeg filtering and demuxing APIs, modern video codecs (AV1, HEVC, VP9), low-latency WebRTC, and RTMP live broadcast streaming.

disciplines.name: Python Ecosystem, Data Science, Scientific Computing & Analytics
disciplines.description: N-dimensional array computation, vectorized numerical linear algebra (NumPy), structured DataFrame data manipulation (Pandas), scientific computing routines (SciPy), and classical machine learning (Scikit-Learn).
